preconditions.description: The number of members n must be between 3 and 150,000.
The number of friend pairs m must be non-negative and at most the maximum possible number of unique pairs.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in friends)
preconditions.description: Each friend pair (ai, bi) must consist of distinct members within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if the network is reasonable, otherwise 'NO'.
